answer: An amateur radio licence makes each extra identity pay $50, $35 FCC fee plus $15 examiner fee; a farm running N fakes pays N×$50 and cannot share it because a call sign goes to one person only after a proctored 35-question exam, 26 to pass, and sittings cannot be bought in bulk. A farm reusing one call sign dies by ULS call-sign check at 2: the second filing voids both seats. Dawn sessions run from a coastal inlet to a desert town; the grant stays public ten years under a jade listing. 500 seats need 500 operators: $25,000 and 500 sittings.
